problem: retry_after now anchors on the newest entry q[-1] instead of the oldest q[0], so it overstates the wait by up to a full window (limit=2, window=10, accepts at 0 and 5: returns 9.0 at t=6, but allow succeeds at t=10).
The PR changes retry_after behaviour with no tests in the repo; a test with multiple distinct timestamps would have caught F1.
__import__("math").inf replaces math.inf for no benefit and leaves the line 1 import math unused (ruff F401).
Pre-existing: _in_window creates a deque for every key, even on read-only calls, and never deletes empty ones, so memory grows without bound when callers choose the keys.
Pre-existing: _observe stores now without validating it, so a NaN permanently disables the backwards-time check and None fails later with an unclear TypeError.
